name: moneyquest
description: MoneyQuest — save money, grow Maple, explore the world.

scripts.reset: MQ_DEMO=1 node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env --input-type=module -e "const { initializeAccounts } = await import('./server/auth.js'); const { resetChild, DEMO_CHILD_ID } = await import('./server/store.js'); initializeAccounts(); resetChild(DEMO_CHILD_ID);"
scripts.phone: npm run build && concurrently -k -n app,phone -c magenta,green "node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env server/index.js" "npx -y cloudflared tunnel --protocol http2 --url http://localhost:8787"
